7 Days in Switzerland: Zurich & Lucerne Express Itinerary

The classic one-week first-timer route linking Zurich and Lucerne by SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways, with easy day trips.

Last reviewed: October 23, 2026 · Prices are approximate and for orientation only.

On this page

  1. Route at a glance
  2. Day-by-day plan

Route at a glance

With one week in Switzerland, splitting your stay between Zurich and Lucerne gives you iconic landmarks, great food neighborhoods, and minimal hotel changes connected by SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways.

Length7 days
Best forFirst-time visitors with one week
BasesZurich (4 nights), Lucerne (3 nights)
PaceModerate, 1 train transfer

Transport & rail pass notes

Take SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways directly between Zurich and Lucerne. Individual advance tickets are usually cheaper than a nationwide pass for a single one-week route.

What to book ahead

  • SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways reserved seats between Zurich and Lucerne
  • Timed-entry tickets for flagship sights in Zurich and Lucerne

Ways to adapt this route

  • Add a day trip from Zurich or Lucerne using regional trains.
  • Extend to 10 days by adding Interlaken, Grindelwald & Jungfrau Region.

Destination guides on this route

Zurich

Riverside Old Town guild houses, Lake Zurich swim clubs, world-class art museums and alpine day-trip rail hub.

Lucerne

Timber Chapel Bridge, frescoed Old Town squares, Lake Lucerne paddle steamers and Mount Pilatus & Rigi.
